description:
Some reasons to choose us!

  • Looking for high quality sauna parts for your infrared sauna?
  • Tired of having to go through several suppliers for different things that you need?
  • We’re here to tell you about one supplier that offers everything that you need under one roof.

InfraredSaunaParts offers an extensive selection of wood parts such as backrests, benches, floors, and walls. We understand the importance of using high-quality wood to ensure there are no harmful toxins or oil that are released into the air when it’s exposed to high temperature. These harmful elements can cause allergic reaction to some customers and in extreme cases it can be fatal.

This is why we take our wood parts seriously and made sure they’re only made of high-quality woods that are hypoallergenic and we’re careful not to use any adhesive that are dangerous to health. Coatings and adhesive can also release harmful gases when subjected to prolonged heat.

Browse through our catalogue to see all of our wood parts for your infrared sauna. Our sauna walls come in various shapes, sizes, styles, and make. We use cedar and hemlock wood to make our sauna walls and you can have them custom built to fit your sauna. Whether you’re looking for a basic wall or one with glass panels, we’re sure you will find exactly what you want by looking through our catalogue.

If you’re not able to, then pick up that phone and let us know what you need. We’re constantly updating our catalogue so we’ll be glad to accommodate your request. Our infrared sauna parts are sold at a highly competitive price so you can be sure you’re getting the best bargain in town and getting goods from us will not tear a large hole in your pocket.

Give your infrared sauna a facelift with our sauna walls and many other items. Call us at the number below and find out how we can help your infrared sauna business grow.
